purpose: Teach: のぞみ/りゅう/秀樹/和彦/優作/三男/英男/誠一

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新幹線のぞみで出張に行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going on a business trip on the Shinkansen Nozomi.
lines.style: Casual, warm delivery. Conversational tone, like sharing a small family update. Light and matter-of-fact, no emphasis needed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんのお友達のりゅうおじさんと将棋指したよ
lines.en: Mom, I played shogi with Dad's friend Uncle Ryu.
lines.style: Quietly proud, the genuine warmth of a small memory. Steady pace. Not showing off—just pleased to share something that mattered. Soft eye contact.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「西城秀樹の曲は懐かしい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that Hideki Saijo's songs bring back memories for him.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly nostalgic tone. Gentle cadence. Speaking as though relaying something meaningful her husband had reflected on. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと和彦おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went and met Dad and Uncle Kazuhiko.
lines.style: Eager but controlled excitement. The warmth of a child who has done something he's proud of. Gentle, not loud—waiting for her response.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「松田優作の映画は名作」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad mentioned that Yusaku Matsuda's films are real masterpieces.
lines.style: Reflective, like she's turning an observation over in her mind. Warm but measured. Saying it as something her husband would appreciate—sharing his taste.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「自分は三男だから跡継ぎを譲った」って語って下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me he's the third son, so he gave up the family succession.
lines.style: Serious and earnest, but gentle. The weight of what he shared comes through without drama. Sho is processing and relaying something adult. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「英男いとこは絵が上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that your cousin Hideo is really talented at drawing.
lines.style: Warm, appreciative tone. The ease of someone sharing family praise. Light and genuine, like she's proud of her cousin-in-law too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと誠一おじさんに会いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to visit Dad and Uncle Seiichi.
lines.style: Warm closure with underlying contentment. The gentle satisfaction of having done something meaningful. Steady, almost peaceful. Soft trailing quality.
